title: Custom Software Development
shortDescription: End-to-end bespoke software engineering tailored to your enterprise workflows and scalability goals.
fullDescription: We architect and build custom enterprise software that maps precisely to your business processes — not the other way around. From discovery and domain modelling through CI/CD deployment and beyond, our full-stack engineers deliver secure, high-performance applications using modern frameworks, microservices architecture, and cloud-native infrastructure. Every solution is designed for horizontal scalability, audit compliance, and long-term maintainability.

solutionArchitecture: We employ a domain-driven design (DDD) approach, decomposing the monolith into bounded contexts aligned with your business capabilities. Each context becomes an independent microservice with its own database, API contract, and deployment pipeline. The frontend uses a component-driven architecture with React and TypeScript, connected via a GraphQL gateway for efficient data fetching. Infrastructure is provisioned as code using Terraform, with Kubernetes orchestrating containerised workloads across multi-AZ clusters.

faqs.question: What is your typical engagement model for custom software?
faqs.answer: We offer fixed-price, time-and-materials, and dedicated team models. For most enterprise engagements, we recommend a 3-phase approach: Discovery (2-4 weeks), MVP (8-12 weeks), and Scale (ongoing).

faqs.question: How do you handle requirement changes during development?
faqs.answer: We use Agile sprints with formal change-request governance. Scope changes are assessed for impact, documented, and approved before inclusion — ensuring predictability without sacrificing flexibility.

faqs.question: Can you integrate with our existing ERP or CRM systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team has extensive experience integrating with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and custom legacy systems. We build adapters and middleware to ensure bi-directional data synchronisation.

faqs.question: What is your post-launch support model?
faqs.answer: We provide L1-L3 support tiers with defined SLAs. Our managed services include 24/7 monitoring, security patching, performance optimisation, and a dedicated technical account manager.

faqs.question: How do you ensure code quality and maintainability?
faqs.answer: Every commit undergoes peer review, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), and static analysis. We maintain a minimum 85% code coverage target and enforce architecture decision records (ADRs) for all significant design choices.

faqs.question: What technologies do you specialise in?
faqs.answer: Our core stack includes Java/Spring Boot, React/Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP. We continuously evaluate emerging technologies and have delivered projects with Rust, Go, and Flutter where appropriate.

faqs.question: How does automated software discovery work?
faqs.answer: Lightweight agents scan installed software, running processes, and registry entries. Data is hashed and transmitted securely to the central repository. No sensitive user data is collected — only software identifiers, versions, and usage timestamps.

faqs.question: Can you handle vendor-specific licence models?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support concurrent, named user, processor-based, core-based, subscription, and consumption-based models. Our rule engine is configurable for vendor-specific metrics and usage calculations.

faqs.question: What happens during a vendor audit?

faqs.question: How do you measure license optimisation savings?
faqs.answer: We baseline current spend, identify unused or under-utilised licences, and project savings based on reallocation or downgrade recommendations. Typical customers see 30-40% reduction in licence spend within the first year.

faqs.question: Do you support cloud and SaaS licences?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate via APIs with major SaaS platforms and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP). We track seat assignments, feature usage, and auto-scaling events to prevent over-provisioning.

faqs.question: How is the solution deployed?
faqs.answer: The central platform is deployed on your infrastructure or as a managed SaaS. Discovery agents are deployed via standard endpoint management tools (Intune, SCCM, Jamf) or manually.

faqs.question: React Native vs native — which do you recommend?
faqs.answer: We evaluate based on performance requirements, budget, and timeline. React Native is ideal for most enterprise apps (80% code reuse, faster time-to-market). Native (Swift/Kotlin) is recommended for apps requiring maximum performance, complex animations, or deep OS integration.

faqs.question: Can the app work offline?

faqs.question: What is your approach to app security?
faqs.answer: Security is built-in from the first sprint. We implement code obfuscation, jailbreak/root detection, encrypted local storage, certificate pinning, and runtime application self-protection (RASP).

faqs.answer: We maintain one-click integrations with LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Monster, Glassdoor, and 20+ regional job boards. Postings are syndicated automatically, and candidate applications are unified in the ATS.

faqs.question: How does AI-powered candidate ranking work?
faqs.answer: The ranking engine combines semantic similarity (resume vs job description), skill gap analysis, and historical hire patterns. Recruiters can adjust ranking weights and provide feedback to improve accuracy over time.

faqs.question: Can the system handle campus hiring volumes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our bulk processing pipeline handles 10,000+ applications per day with automated screening, test scheduling, and shortlisting. Group interview management and offer batch processing streamline campus hiring.

faqs.question: How does interview scheduling work?
faqs.answer: The scheduler reads interviewer calendars, identifies optimal time slots, and sends interview invites with one-click confirmation. It handles timezone conversion, room booking, and video conference link generation.

faqs.question: Do you provide diversity hiring tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform tracks demographic data (voluntary self-identification), generates diversity reporting, and provides bias detection in job descriptions and screening criteria. Anonymisation mode removes identifiable information during initial screening.

faqs.question: How do you ensure data privacy for candidates?
faqs.answer: Candidate data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We comply with GDPR, CCPA, and local data protection regulations. Candidates can request data access, correction, or deletion at any time. Data retention policies are configurable.

We deliver across major VR platforms including Meta Quest, HTC Vive, and PICO headsets.

faqs.question: Which VR platforms do you support?
faqs.answer: We develop for Meta Quest 2/3/Pro, HTC Vive Focus 3, PICO 4, and Windows Mixed Reality. For broader accessibility, we also deploy WebXR experiences that run in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge browsers without a headset.

faqs.question: How realistic are the training simulations?
faqs.answer: We use physically-based rendering (PBR), spatial audio, and haptic feedback to create high-fidelity environments. For medical training, we partner with surgical instrument manufacturers for accurate 3D models. For manufacturing, we scan real facilities for 1:1 digital twins.

faqs.question: Can multiple trainees use the system simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our multiplayer architecture supports up to 50 concurrent users in shared virtual environments. Instructors can observe, guide, and assess multiple trainees simultaneously from a control panel.

faqs.question: How do you measure training effectiveness?
faqs.answer: The platform captures detailed performance metrics: task completion time, error rate, gaze path, hand movement efficiency, and decision accuracy. Pre- and post-training assessments quantify knowledge retention and skills improvement.

faqs.question: What hardware do we need to deploy?
faqs.answer: For standalone VR (Quest, PICO), no additional hardware is needed. For PC VR, we specify workstations with RTX 4070 or better. For multi-user setups, we recommend a dedicated VR server with 10Gbps network connectivity.

faqs.question: Can you create custom content for our specific equipment or processes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 3D artists and subject matter experts work with your team to create accurate digital twins of your equipment, facilities, and processes. Content authoring tools enable your team to update scenarios independently.

faqs.question: What are your SLA commitments?
faqs.answer: We offer three tiers: Bronze (business hours, 8-hour response), Silver (24/7, 4-hour response for P1), and Gold (24/7, 1-hour response for P1 with dedicated TAM). All tiers include 99.9% uptime guarantee with financial penalties for breaches.

faqs.question: How do you handle after-hours emergencies?
faqs.answer: Our 24/7 NOC uses PagerDuty for intelligent alert routing. On-call engineers are equipped with remote access tools and runbooks for rapid diagnosis. Critical incidents (P1) trigger a war-room conference bridge within 15 minutes.

faqs.question: Can you support custom or legacy applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our L3 engineering team specialises in maintaining and modernising legacy systems (Java 8, .NET Framework, COBOL integrations). We document undocumented systems, create automated tests, and implement observability where missing.

faqs.question: What does proactive maintenance include?
faqs.answer: Proactive maintenance includes: security patching (monthly), performance tuning (quarterly), database optimisation (monthly), log rotation and archival, backup verification, dependency updates, and capacity planning reviews.

faqs.question: How do you manage changes to production?
faqs.answer: All changes follow ITIL change management: RFC submission, CAB review (for standard changes), testing in staging, production deployment during maintenance windows, and rollback procedures. Emergency changes follow an expedited process with post-implementation review.

faqs.question: Can you take over support from a previous vendor?
faqs.answer: Yes. We follow a structured transition process: knowledge transfer (1-2 weeks), environment access and documentation review, shadowing period (2-4 weeks), and full ownership transfer. We have successfully transitioned 40+ engagements from previous vendors.
